title: Cloudastructure Reports 101% Year-Over-Year Growth in Subscription Revenue for the Third Quarter 2026
body_markdown:
*Total Revenue Increases 6% Year Over Year and Approximately 25% Sequentially to $1.54 Million*


*Subscription Revenue Expands to 55% of Total Revenue as Cloud Video Surveillance and Remote Guarding Revenue Grew 117% and 85% Year Over Year, Respectively*


*Conference Call to be Held on November 17, 2026 at 12:00 P.M. ET*


PALO ALTO, Calif., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cloudastructure, Inc. (“Cloudastructure” or “the Company”) (Nasdaq: CSAI), a leader in cloud-native AI surveillance and remote guarding solutions, today reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 and provided a business update.


“Our third quarter results reflect continued progress in building the recurring revenue foundation of our business,” said James McCormick, CEO of Cloudastructure. “Subscription revenue increased 101% year over year, with strong growth across both cloud video surveillance and remote guarding and represented approximately 55% of total revenue compared with 29% a year ago. While lower installation and other revenue moderated overall revenue growth, we believe the increasing contribution from subscriptions is an important measure of our progress toward building a more scalable business. Customers are also expanding beyond initial deployments, including an existing multifamily relationship that grew from five properties earlier this year to nine active deployments following quarter-end.”


“We see a significant opportunity as property owners and operators combine AI-powered surveillance with live remote guarding to modernize their security operations,” continued Mr. McCormick. “We are investing in sales, marketing and operations to support customer acquisition, deployments and the expansion of remote guarding, and our operating expenses and net loss increased during the quarter. Our focus is on translating those investments into sustained subscription revenue growth while improving operating efficiency as we scale. We believe our integrated platform positions Cloudastructure to deepen customer relationships, expand across additional properties and win new business.”


**Key Financial and Operational Highlights:**


- **Subscription Revenue Growth:** Subscription services revenue increased 101% year-over-year to approximately $853,000, driven by cloud video surveillance revenue growth of 117% and remote guarding revenue growth of 85%.
- **Revenue Mix Shift:** Subscription services represented approximately 55% of total revenue in the third quarter, compared with approximately 29% in the prior year period, as installation and other revenue declined.
- **Recurring Revenue Run Rate:** Third quarter subscription revenue implies an annualized run rate of approximately $3.4 million based on recurring revenue as of the end of September 2026.
- **Gross Profit Expansion:** Gross profit increased 9% year-over-year to approximately $785,000, with gross margin of approximately 51%, compared with approximately 50% in the prior year period.
- **Sequential Growth:** Total revenue increased approximately 25% and subscription revenue increased approximately 12% compared with the second quarter of 2026.
- **Total Revenue:** Third quarter revenue was $1.54 million, an increase of approximately 6% compared with $1.45 million in the prior year period.
- **Nine-Month Performance:** Revenue for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was approximately $4.1 million, an increase of approximately 25% over the same period in 2025, with gross profit up approximately 45%.


**Multifamily Expansion and Customer Growth**


Subsequent to the end of the quarter, the Company announced two additional deployments with an existing multifamily portfolio customer, expanding the relationship from five properties earlier this year to nine active deployments and demonstrating the Company’s land-and-expand strategy as successful initial deployments lead to broader portfolio adoption.


**Financial Results for the Third Quarter Ended September 30, 2026:**


- Revenue for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 was $1.54 million, compared to $1.45 million for the same period in 2025, an increase of approximately 6% year-over-year.


- Subscription services revenue increased to $853,000 from $424,000, an increase of approximately 101%, led by cloud video surveillance revenue growth of approximately 117% and remote guarding revenue growth of approximately 85%. Hardware revenue increased to $412,000 from $347,000, while installation and other revenue decreased to $274,000 from $679,000, reflecting the Company’s continued shift toward recurring, subscription-based revenue.


- Cost of goods sold for the third quarter was $754,000, compared to $731,000 in the prior year period, an increase of approximately 3%, reflecting higher hosting, data center bandwidth and remote guarding costs to support subscription growth, largely offset by lower installation labor costs.


- Gross profit increased to $785,000, compared to $719,000 in the third quarter of 2025, representing approximately 9% year-over-year growth. Gross margin was approximately 51%, compared to approximately 50% in the prior year period, reflecting the increased contribution from recurring service offerings.


- Operating expenses for the quarter totaled approximately $3.8 million, compared to approximately $2.7 million in the prior year period, reflecting increased sales and marketing and research and development investment and higher operations headcount to support deployment and remote guarding scale. Third quarter operating expenses included $548,000 of non-cash stock-based compensation expense related to the repricing of stock options on August 27, 2026.


- General and administrative expenses for the quarter were approximately $1.4 million, compared to approximately $1.0 million in the prior year period, an increase of approximately 34%, primarily reflecting higher professional services costs, partially offset by lower salaries and consulting fees.


- Net loss for the third quarter was approximately $3.1 million, compared to approximately $1.3 million in the same period in 2025. The prior year period included a non-cash gain of $628,000 on the change in fair value of derivative liabilities; the derivative liability was retired on June 29, 2026, and there was no corresponding gain in the current period. (Prior year comparative figures have been revised in connection with the technical accounting matter related to the Company’s Series 1 and Series 2 Convertible Preferred Stock. The revision did not affect cash, operations, revenue, or operating expenses.)


- As of September 30, 2026, the Company had cash on hand of approximately $2.2 million.

**About Cloudastructure**
Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, Cloudastructure’s patented award-winning security platform utilizes a scalable cloud-based architecture that features cloud video surveillance with proprietary, state-of-the-art AI/ML analytics, and a seamless remote guarding solution. The combination enables enterprise businesses to achieve proactive, end-to-end security, and pairs that platform with an attractive value proposition that eschews proprietary hardware and offers contract-free, month-to-month pricing and unlimited 24/7 support. With Cloudastructure, companies can achieve unparalleled situational awareness in real time and thereby stop crime as it is happening, while simultaneously achieving up to a 75% lower Total Cost of Ownership than other systems. For more information, visit[https://www.cloudastructure.com](https://www.cloudastructure.com/) .
